jobs_results.title: Regulatory Compliance Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

We are SGS – the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 97,000 employees operate a network of 2,650 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Regulatory Compliance product manager to join SGS DIGICOMPLY in Chiasso and lead our clients onboardings, Regulatory and food safety project implementations and renewals. This role is fundamental in ensuring that customers are getting the most out of the SGS Digicomply platform. You'll play a key role to complete the pre- and post-sales life-cycle for SGS DIGICOMPLY’s portfolio of customers, serving as an advocate for each customer and accelerating the expansion of SGS DIGICOMPLY within each account.

What your day to day will look like:
• Provide customer and account management support in a technical... setting
• Maintain and support of our data collection pipeline composed of regulatory, scientific and supply chains data in relation to food and cosmetics products risks
• Use product expertise and industry knowledge to engage with a diverse range of customers
• Serve as the trusted point of contact for SGS DIGICOMPLY’S customers throughout the lifecycle, beginning from the point of sale and extending through on-boarding, business reviews, project success, and renewals.
• Ability to understand customer requirements and feed those to the Sales and Product teams to deepen penetration of SGS DIGICOMPLY solution within the customer environment
• Maintain great technical knowledge of the SGS DIGICOMPLY product and guide our clients through the most relevant features and functionalities for their specific business needs.
• Collaborate with the Account executives, Support and software development to ensure a smooth transition of ongoing client management.

Qualifications

Requirements:
• 3-4 years of Regulatory Compliance project manager experience in a SaaS company
• Experience in Food products, food safety or regulatory compliance for CPG industries or Food Supplements.
• Strong analytical and technical skills with an attention to detail
• Excellent communication skills: utilized with our clients, as well as delivering effective feedback to your peers and management.
• Accustomed to working effectively both independently and as a team player in a fast-paced start-up environment with members located across the world.
• Strong leadership skills

Additional Information

The position might be remote and we`d like to hear from candidates within EU countries

jobs_results.title: Project Manager (Flemish Market) - Permanent contract
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a Project Manager to join our team in Madrid!

Context of the position
• The Project Manager is integrated into the international team in Madrid. You would have to develop our partnership with a French company specializing in informing citizens about their social benefits and helping them to obtain these benefits. The company has successfully partnered with the home contracts comparison website Selectra to grow a common business in France, and then to duplicate it to other countries.
• You will join a team of two individuals under the direct supervision of the International Project Manager. Your main mission will be to grow the common business on the Belgium market.
• You will own yourself each and every step of the conversion funnel and be responsible for its growth:
• Development of the website https://mijntoeslagen.be/ (write new content, optimize the existing one, maintenance of the simulator) in order to generate qualified traffic ;
• Continuous improvement of... the monetization of the website ;
• Continuous improvement of the sales process, in collaboration with the call center sales team;
• Daily reporting of traffic, conversion and sales.

Outcomes to be accomplished

Project management and administration
• Local market research and compilation of public data to develop an understanding of the market
• Product management of the digital tool, and monitoring of its development by the technical team

Marketing strategy and content
• Creation of a sitemap, writing and updating and integration of articles
• SEO optimization and monetization of existing web content to make it more ergonomic and improve its referencing
• Definition and follow-up of a digital acquisition campaign, in conjunction with Selectra's specialized department: Google Adwords Search, Facebook Ads…
• Following and analyzing KPIs and use of tools such as Google Analytics or Google Search Console on a regular basis

Sales strategy (in collaboration with the Sales Manager and the Country Manager)
• Definition and monitoring of lead handling processes, and continuous improvement
• Performance monitoring and reporting, and continuous improvement

Profile

Dutch / Flemish is your mother tongue, French is a big plus, Spanish a small plus. You are also fluent in English.

You recognize yourself in the following:
• You have an interest in digital marketing best practices (SEO/SEA). Ideally, you have previous experience in content management and/or web marketing.

Fit competencies:
• At Selectra, we’re looking for efficient and organized people. We work in a fast-paced environment, where we expect you to move forward very quickly when defining and executing strategies.
• You are autonomous and proactive and always anticipate finding new and innovative approaches to all kinds of possible problems.
• You are objective-focused and give visibility to people around you about your progress.
• You are able to structure and process data and draw insightful conclusions.
• We expect you to be a team-player and to actively listen and understand your coworkers’ viewpoints.

Why Selectra?
• Madrid! You’ll be seduced by this city with a dreamy atmosphere and culture where everybody feels welcome.
• You’ll benefit from the flexibility and reactivity of a company with a start-up spirit (flat hierarchy, chill environment)
• A truly international company: we count more than 20 nationalities and make sure you can talk with everyone by offering free language classes!
• Company events: we work hard and love to celebrate once work is done! We organize monthly team events as well as 3 company-wide afterworks per year.
• You’ll have responsibilities within a dynamic team, here to train and assist you when needed
• We’re good at what we do: you’ll have the opportunity to work with the best SEO teams in Europe and be part of an international and multicultural team with more than 60 content officers working on SEO on a daily basis
• We care about your health and well being:
• preferential tariffs on your Gym subscription.
• Fresh fruits delivered every week
• But especially, a work environment where we never let unhealthy HR situations unattended.

Company overview

Selectra works hard to make the world cheaper, greener and simpler by offering home contracts comparison, subscription and management services. Initially targeting energy price comparison, Selectra extended its focus to broadband and mobile plans as well as to insurance and banking. In the long run, Selectra aims at becoming the spontaneous choice of consumers willing to gather all of their home contracts and recurring expenses into a single powerful management tool.

With over 1700 team members in 17 countries around the world, and over 409 millions visitors on its websites in 2022, Selectra is a leading European startup. It has been ranked #180 fastest-growing French startups by LesEchos in 2022 and has been listed on multiple occasions in the Financial Times ranking of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.

Working at Selectra is a stimulating experience as we try to only hire humble individuals having in common a real passion for their job as well as outstanding skills in their area of expertise. Age and experience don’t count as much as fast learning skills at Selectra, where young graduates often occupy top management positions. We strive to stay away from frequent work cultures’ flaws (useless meetings, bureaucracy, slowness...). We never leave unhealthy situations unattended. In a nutshell, we create the conditions for a serene work environment where being kind and helpful to each other comes naturally, which we believe is a condition to attract the best talents and achieve high performance.

Recruitment process
• HR interview
• Writing and SEO test
• Interview with the International Project Manager
• Interview with International Manager and- our partner
• Response to your application within 2 weeks maximum.

No consideration of gender, age, skin color, sexual orientation or other discriminatory reasons will interfere with the selection process at Selectra.

We inform you that the data concerning you are computerized and treated confidentially. Your data will be kept for up to three years after you have submitted your application. Only persons employed in the human resources department will be able to access your data for strictly internal purposes. You can access, correct or delete your data by contacting < email deleted for security reasons

jobs_results.title: Crisis & Incident Management Program Manager
jobs_results.description:
POSITION DETAILS

Position Title: Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager

Department: Security

Location: Malakoff, France; Redhill, UK, Barcelona, Spain or Shannon, Ireland

POSITION SUMMARY

The ambition of the security organization is to evolve to a business partner role, delivering value to the business while reducing and managing their risk. This by following a risk-based strategy and security improvement program with common objectives and controls.

The Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager is a part of Central team, and is a key discipline within Operational Resilience department to ensure that Business Continuity, IT Service Continuity, and Crisis & Incident management within the AXA Partners countries is defined, implemented, and delivered in accordance with the Group Security Strategy and supports to achieve local maturity objectives in cost-effective manner.

DIMENSIONS OF ROLE

As Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager, you will be part of the... central Operational Resilience team and, reporting directly to Chief Operational Resilience Officer, while working closely with Operational resilience community including local Incident Management teams across AXA Partners countries located in Europe, North America, and LATAM.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Support the AXA Partners Crisis Coordinator in advancing the Crisis and Incident management Group framework and controls globally.

· Achieve incident and crisis management maturity targets with effective controls in place.

· Collaborate with local incident management teams to ensure the implementation of proper incident management structures and processes, including high-risk scenario testing, event logs, incident logs, post-mortem analysis, and remedial action plans.

· Consolidate and present risks and gaps to the Operational Resilience steering committee.

· Assist with internal and external audit requests and assurance reviews, and support the crisis coordinator during major incidents and crises.

· Provide oversight across all disciplines for the Chief Operational Resilience Officer, including crisis and incident management controls, global documentation, strategy, and implementation in countries.

· Collaborate with and support the Group Security Practice, interacting with various stakeholders to ensure the effectiveness of processes and controls.

· Advise local countries on the implementation and maintenance of incident/crisis management processes and controls, and support Regional Security Managers in their Operational Resilience activities.

· Ensure the implementation of policies, shared security services, and action plans based on the Group Security Strategy.

· Identify and analyze risks, recommend mitigation options, and ensure the quality and consistency of reporting and action plans produced at both local and regional levels.

Your Profile

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

You have a Bachelor's degree in computer science, management information systems or information security. You have several years of experience working in the security field and you have a strong understanding of business continuity, IT service continuity, and crisis/incident management practices and standards, including DRII, BCI materials, ISO 22301, and 22316. Awareness of relevant regulations, particularly in DORA, is advantageous. Experience in business continuity, IT service continuity, crisis and incident management, security risk analysis, and information security is essential, with additional experience in the financial/insurance/assistance industry being beneficial. You are proficient in data management and reporting tools, fluent in English (with additional languages such as French or Spanish being an asset), excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to plan and execute projects are crucial. You can work autonomously and you possess strong interpersonal and communication skills. Experience with ClearView, SendWordNow, and SharePoint is a plus.

#LI-UK

Join a company that helps protect the forests! At AXA Partners, we plant a tree for every new recruit (with a permanent contract). Learn more about the Reforest Program here.

About AXA

AXA Group is the world leader in insurance and asset management. We protect and advise our clients at every step in their lives, by offering products and services which satisfy their needs in the areas of insurance, personal protection, saving and asset management. AXA is the leading insurance brand worldwide, with over 100 million clients. We are transforming from payer to partner for our client, with a strong focus on risk prevention.

Our mission: Empower people to live a better life.

Our values: Customer First, Courage, Integrity and One AXA.

About the Entity

AXA Partners is an AXA transversal business unit offering a wide range of solutions in assistance services, travel insurance and credit protection.

AXA Partners’ role is also to implement innovative solutions emerging from the AXA Innovation unit.

Combining passion with advanced expertise, we design and deliver worldwide solutions for partners and communities. We protect what matters, when it matters.

Join a company that helps protect the forests! At AXA Partners, we plant a tree for every new recruit (with a permanent contract).

What We Offer

At AXA Partners, we’re appreciative of the people who work for us and our rewards package is reviewed regularly to reflect that. You can expect to receive:

Competitive annual salary
Annual company & performance-based bonus
Group Personal Pension Plan
Life Assurance (4x Annual Salary)
Private Healthcare Benefit
AXA employee discounts

We look for candidates with the right skills and values to join us and selection is based on a fair and equal process. We’re committed to providing equal opportunities for all, therefore we welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds

jobs_results.title: IT Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 300 million pallets, crates and containers.

We employ 11,000 people and operate in more than 55 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.

What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner.

You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals.

And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our .

Job Description

To manage and ensure successful end to end delivery of IT projects or IT work stream of business projects to agreed time, cost, and quality.

Key... Accountabilities
• Develop project scope and objectives, the identification & evaluation of options for project delivery and the preparation of a project documentations and plans
• Ensure that IT solution requirements are defined, delivered, and monitored
• Ensure quality control procedures are used correctly
• Establish the IT solution delivery project team(s) working methods
• Develop schedules and work packages for the IT project delivery team
• Manage hand-over of responsibility for the IT solution to business-as-usual support
• Build appropriate and effective business relationships.
• Advise on the available standards, methods, tools, and applications relevant to own specialism and can make appropriate choices from alternatives.
• Facilitate collaboration between stakeholders who have diverse objectives.
• Is fully accountable for meeting allocated technical and / or project / supervisory objectives.
• Has significant influence over the allocation and management of resources appropriate to given assignments and in the delegation of project responsibilities.
• Make decisions which impact the success of assigned projects i.e. results, deadlines and budget

Skills and Knowledge

Stakeholder relationship management
• Collects and uses feedback from customers and stakeholders to help measure effectiveness of stakeholder management.
• Implements a communications strategy, including -but not limited to- handling of complaints; problems and issues; managing resolutions;

corrective actions and lessons learned; collection and dissemination of relevant information appropriately.

Project management
• Takes full responsibility for the definition and entire management from start to finish including -but not limited to- costs, schedule, resources, risks, quality, testing, documentation and change management until production with satisfactory completion of medium-scale projects (typically lasting 6-12 months, with direct business impact, teams of 3-5 and firm deadlines).
• Provides effective leadership to the project team and takes appropriate action where team performance deviates from agreed tolerances.

Third party supplier relationship management
• Develops and manages contracts with suppliers to meet key performance indicators and agreed targets, taking account of information security of third parties.
• Carries out benchmarking and makes use of supplier performance data to ensure that supplier performance is properly monitored and regularly reviewed.
• Is responsible for the management and implementation of supplier service improvement actions and programmes.

Experience
• Significant previous experience in within an IT focussed role.
• 5+ years’ experience managing or influencing technical staff and projects.
• Proven success in improving the customer experience.
• Experience working within a matrix structure.

Desirable Qualifications

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

Oasis is a privacy focused L1 blockchain with a highly scalable, cross-chain enabled architecture that is able to provide data sovereignty and on-chain privacy to the whole Web3 ecosystem. The Oasis Protocol Foundation supports projects focused on building privacy-preserving applications on top of the Oasis Network.

Objective:

The primary objective of the Project Manager is to ensure the successful planning, execution, and delivery of projects within the marketing, community and business development domains. This includes managing project timelines, budgets, resources, and risks to meet business objectives and stakeholder expectations.

Key Responsibilities:
• Sort and maintain the task lists for the Community, Marketing and Business Development teams.
• Suggest and implement project management tools to improve task coordination and lead the effort to put processes in place to improve team productivity.
• Monitor project... progress and adjust plans as necessary to ensure adherence to deadlines and quality standards.
• Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status, risks, and issues.
• Conduct regular reviews and inspections to identify defects and implement corrective actions.
• Compile lessons learned and best practices for future reference and improvement.
• Allocate resources effectively to ensure project tasks are completed on time and within budget.
• Set up and organize meetings for the Community, Marketing and Business Development teams.
• Sync up with leads of other teams to schedule syncs and discussions when needed.
• Handle external communication with partners and service providers.

Key Person Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience as a project manager or similar role in a technology or blockchain company.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work with teams across different departments such as: Marketing, Community and Business Development.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to improve processes and identify areas for improvement.
• Experience in implementing project management tools and processes to improve team productivity.

Interview Process:
• Initial screening call with Recruitment team to discuss qualifications and experience.
• Technical interview with the Director of Operations to discuss project management tools and processes.
• Cross-team collaboration interview with BD and Engineering / Community and Marketing team representatives
• Final interview with the team leads and upper management to assess fit and discuss specific responsibilities and expectations.

This is a great time to join Oasis Foundation.

Location: The role can be based anywhere with flexible and remote work options. Europe time zone is preferred.

Please note: This is a full-time role that will be paid in USDT OR USDC cryptocurrency.

IT Integration Project Manager

Job description

Role Overview

The IT Integration Project Manager has the responsibility of assigned IT integration projects, focused on API and Event Notification Implementation. Plans and coordinates all aspects of assigned projects from initiation through delivery in effective collaboration with other IT Teams.

The candidate will be focused primarily on linking on-premises and cloud-based enterprise software applications, including ERP, CRM, devices (IOT) and custom solutions to meet business needs aligned within the Nippon Gases Integration strategy.

General characteristics

The newly appointed role involves the coordination of integration projects, contributing to the company's integration strategy and supporting IT projects where multiple systems need to be integrated. Projects will be executed in collaboration with other IT teams and external partners to ensure successful and timely implementation of interfaces.

Projects should be assessed by... both the business and IT teams, prioritized, and executed using the project management methodology. It is imperative that they are delivered on time, within the budget and meet the highest quality standards while satisfying customer expectations.

Key responsibilities
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field or equivalent work experience.
• Project Management certification or successful completion of a recognized project management curriculum.
• Contribute to analyze, design and coordinate the execution of integration services (APIs) within the integration architecture standards.
• Be involved in the development life cycle and perform definition and feasibility analysis.
• Provide expert advice to project teams on use of integration architecture including integration best practices.
• Oversee critical steps within the Integration projects that impact enterprise projects.
• Work with project teams in definition of requirements for integration requests of their projects into the Enterprise Architecture.
• Work with integration architect to coordinate project planning and assess the necessary activities to successfully implement the projects.
• Manage internal resources as well as augmented or externally sourced team members.
• Communicate project status to various levels of management.
• Partner with leaders of other disciplines to ensure proposed solutions align with information, technology, infrastructure, business and security architectures.
• Deliver quality results on time with minimal supervision.
The Integration project manager will be located in Madrid and will report to the IT Integration Senior Manager.
• Job requirements
• 7+ years of experience in IT project management position with proven experience in management of complex projects.

Knowledge of process improvement and high-performance project team management.
• Excellent knowledge in English, both written/spoken
• Considered very valuable the knowledge of integration technology platforms and capabilities across MuleSoft, SAP and Microsoft Azure API Management Services.
• Knowledge of enterprise and systems architecture, standards, frameworks, and practices.
• Expertise in solution design and functional analysis, vendor management, enterprise application support, in addition to strong business understanding and project management.
• Experience with the implementation of Continuous Integration practices and tooling to support automated build, delivery and regression test of commercial software.
• Proven experience in managing relationships with vendors/consultants, IT teams and internal stakeholders.
• Outstanding communications skills to be able to effectively interface with high level business owners, key-users, and IT specialists
• Interest in staying hands-on technical while wearing project management role.
• Problem solving/support-oriented attitude, proactive, result-oriented
• Ability to handle multiple tasks under tight deadlines
• Organization, creativity, flexibility, and strong analytical skills

About Us

Nippon Gases is one of the leading companies in the industrial and medical gases business in Europe. We service more than 150,000 customers and have a diversified involvement in broad industries such as healthcare, food, manufacturing, metallurgy, chemical products, electronics and energy. We aim to create social value through innovative gas solutions that increase industrial productivity, enhance human well-being and contribute to a more sustainable future.

Making life better through gas technology.

What can you expect from us?

We are an industrial company in which safety and integrity come first, as it could not be otherwise. We bet on the talent of each of our employees, creating opportunities for development and learning, as well as offering an environment of personal conciliation. Our employees are the key to achieve high customer satisfaction and be, day by day, your choice. We have a high commitment to society and respect for the environment. These values make us a great company with solid and continuous financial results.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

Nippon Gases is a company committed to equality and promotes an inclusive work environment free of any type of discrimination and harassment. We believe that the diversity of talent strengthens and increases our success. We have equality policies that guarantee employability and increase opportunities for all candidates

jobs_results.description:
Jobbeschreibung Zusammenfassung

Projects & Tender Sourcing Leader

Stellenbeschreibung

Role purpose

Deliver competitive advantages and drive cost out initiatives to enable profitable growth.

Connect sourcing imperatives with the product lines strategies and to aim at creating One team by increasing collaboration and synergies with different stakeholders in the work location, other functions, regions, and business lines.

Involve all Sourcing activities in the Inquiry to Order (ITO) opportunity preparation & optimization.

Involve all Sourcing activities in the Order to Revenue (OTR) and implement sourcing process and procedures with value addition

Manage a vendor list based on Global Sourcing strategy

Identify risk & opportunities during ITO opportunity preparation

Seeks sustainable competitiveness improvements, supports the regional product optimization initiatives.

Involve in the supplier qualification and onboarding process

Manage a vendor list based on Global Sourcing... strategy

Identify risk & opportunities during ITO opportunity preparation

Seeks sustainable competitiveness improvements, supports the regional product optimization initiatives.

Essential responsibilities

Define supplier strategy including management and optimization of supplier panels. Lead negotiations and allocate needs to specific suppliers. Negotiate terms and conditions and transmit information to Procurement. Manage claims. Includes commercial sourcing management such as data analysis, negotiations support and more. This may also include purchasing activities.

Developing in-depth knowledge of business disciplines. Uses prior experience and acquired expertise to execute functional policy/strategy.

A job at this level is likely to be an individual contributor, with proven interpersonal skills. Communication with direct colleagues and the business about design and coordination services rendered. Provide informal guidance to new team members. Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations.

Represent ITO (Inquiry To Order) Sourcing during Tender stage for his/her respective area. Reinforce the interface between Sourcing and Tendering teams in the preparation of new business opportunities. Ensure cost and Leadtime accuracy, competitive sourcing scheme and relevant Risk and Opportunity analysis.

Represent OTR (Order To Revenue) Sourcing during project execution stage for his/her respective area. Strong interface with project execution team for successful completion of the projects within the timeline and cost.

Maintain highest level of QEHS standards as per the company’s guidelines whilst interacting and taking decision with internal and external stakeholders.

Impacts projects, processes, and procedures in own field. The role operates with some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities/provision of advice within an enabling discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Activities require professional judgment but may require more senior levels of guidance.

Utilizes technical expertise and judgement to solve problems. Leverages technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.

Ensure implementation of Global Sourcing policy (QMS/BMS) in our ITO and OTR activities, contribute to cost optimizations and ensure their solidity and scope maturity with his/her regional management and with Global Commodity Leaders.

Initiate, engage and contribute for organization’s sustainability roadmap and objectives.

Contribute to the optimization of sourcing strategy on prioritized product segments.

Coordination in ITO/OTR with the regional commodity Leader and Global Commodity Leader to deliver the best cost and cycle scenario taking into consideration all SQDC (Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost)

Highlight and mitigate the Sourcing Risk at ITO stage and contribute for margin improvement at OTR stage

Manage and maintain strategic and close relations with suppliers’ and subcontractors’ decision makers and key stakeholders.

Good internal networking within Sourcing and other functions of the organization.

Work towards achieving or exceeding the yearly KPIs and objectives with periodic update to the line manager and dotted line reporting.

Desired characteristics

Project Sourcing skills
Good knowledge for digitalization
Global business acumen & strategic vision
Action oriented/Creativity/Motivating others/Drive for results/Organization
Ability to understand commodity sourcing strategies
Ability to make decision/sense of urgency
Cross-cultural management, Presentation skills
Ability to Work in a team, Communication skills
Negotiation/ Influencing
Language skill: Flaunt in Spanish and English

Qualification/Requirement

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma with at least 6 years of experience in Job Family Group(s)/Function(s)).

Ability to work in a global environment and matrix organization.

Organizational reporting

GSI South Europe Projects Sourcing Leader

Work Location

Coslada, Madrid, Spain / Work from office is preferred

Zusätzliche Informationen

Umzugshilfe bereitgestellt: Nein

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Configuration and Change Manager
jobs_results.description:
Req ID:449223

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Senior Project Configuration and Change Manager in Santa Perpetua de Mogoda (Barcelona) we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your change management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and proactive teammates.

You'll master the quality of deliveries by ensuring accuracy, consistency, and traceability of the delivered products and services through the application of Change and Configuration (CCM) activities in portfolio of projects, including projects with high criticality... Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (production, project management), be accountable that all Project/Program stakeholders apply the CCM process and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of keeping the project/program configuration under control and manage changes during the whole lifecycle of the Project or Program, but also managing the team of Project Configuration and Change Managers in Barcelona/ Santa Perpetua Site.

We’ll look to you for:
• Leads the Configuration and Change Management (CCM) for a project.
• Is accountable and reports on CCM Performance Indicators on site; derives and manages actions (PDCA).
• Represents the CCM Métier in project and site meetings.
• Leads the application of Configuration and Change standard procedures, instructions, templates, tools etc. and ensures that team members do not bypass them.
• Ensures the execution of CCM audits and DfQ Gates for CCM deliverables.
• Performs REX for CCM and leads improvements of the CCM activities on site.
• Ensures the activities and Roles & Responsibilities defined in the Configuration Management Plan (CMP) are applied and followed.
• Evaluates and provides or approves the compliance statement on all CCM related requirements (i.e. customer, partner and internal).
• Promotes the Alstom Code of Ethics and adheres to the highest standards of ethical conduct.

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• Graduate of University degree in any of Engineering/Project Management/Business Management or equivalent.
• Expert knowledge of Configuration & Change Management.
• Leadership skills to coordinate a team of professionals engaged in specific tasks related to CCM. As such drives change, is a team contributor and sets a good environment for team colleagues.
• Comprehensive communication and negotiation skills and the ability to guide, influence and convince others even without formal leadership.
• Detailed knowledge and/or previous experience of Business Process Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Requirements Management Supply Chain, Engineering, Industrialization, Data Management and Document Control inter-related with CCM.
• Detailed knowledge of Alstom configuration & change processes and related processes of contributing Métiers/ / Functions.
• Above 5 years of experience in a configuration and change management role
• Work experience in an international environment.
• Desirable: experience in the entire CCM lifecycle of a Project/Program.
• Desirable: CMII Certificate
• Fluent English language skills; Spanish an advantage

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with cutting-edge projects in rolling stock
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our cooperative working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone
